scope: Static requirements of the committed E1 drive page (probes/e1-drive/web) as read from the source on 2026-11-08. Every entry cites the file:line that makes it a requirement. This file does not claim retail Blur behaviour; it describes what the current page needs from a browser.

webgpu.featureNote: packet-consumer.js:566-568 calls navigator.gpu.requestAdapter() and adapter.requestDevice() with no descriptor. No optional WebGPU feature is required: no timestamp query, no f16, no storage buffers, no compatibility mode. The page therefore runs on a default device, which is capped by the WebGPU default limits (measured on this machine: maxBufferSize 268,435,456 B, maxTextureDimension2D 8192, maxBindGroups 4), not by the adapter's higher ceilings. Every required limit below is checked against both the adapter limits and the requested device limits.

limitCitations.maxBufferSize: packet-consumer.js:766-777 (car/map index and vertex buffers; the largest is the Gracia merged index buffer, 1,651,896 x 4 = 6,607,584 B, and the positions buffer, 738,905 x 12 = 8,866,860 B; measured by tools/measure_requirements.mjs)
limitCitations.maxTextureDimension2D: packet-consumer.js:855-869 creates one rgba8unorm-srgb texture per packet texture record; the largest committed uploaded image is 512 x 512 (level/track/car/map textures, measured)
limitCitations.maxBindGroups: packet-consumer.js:607-609 pipeline layout uses three bind group layouts (draw, scene, texture)
limitCitations.maxBindingsPerBindGroup: packet-consumer.js:591-606: one binding in each of the three groups
limitCitations.maxUniformBuffersPerShaderStage: packet-consumer.js:591-600: draw uniform (vertex+fragment) and scene uniform (fragment)
limitCitations.maxUniformBufferBindingSize: packet-consumer.js:137-138,595,599,960: DRAW_UNIFORM_BYTES = 160 and scene minBindingSize = 48, binding size is 160
limitCitations.maxSampledTexturesPerShaderStage: packet-consumer.js:601-606,872-878: one texture_2d<f32> in the fragment stage
limitCitations.maxSamplersPerShaderStage: packet-consumer.js:601-606,872-878: one filtering sampler in the fragment stage
limitCitations.maxVertexAttributes: packet-consumer.js:616-617: float32x3 at location 0 and float32x2 at location 1
limitCitations.maxColorAttachmentBytesPerSample: packet-consumer.js:583-584: preferred canvas format (bgra8unorm or rgba8unorm, 4 B) and no additional targets
limitCitations.maxSamplerAnisotropy: packet-consumer.js:569-574,665-673 reads adapter.limits.maxSamplerAnisotropy and clamps to 1 when it is absent. Current WebGPU has removed that limit from GPUSupportedLimits, so the measured value is null and the applied anisotropy is 1. Anisotropy is therefore optional and not a requirement.

hardAssumptions.name: minUniformBufferOffsetAlignment
hardAssumptions.note: DRAW_UNIFORM_STRIDE = 256 is hard-coded as the dynamic-offset stride (packet-consumer.js:137). A device whose minUniformBufferOffsetAlignment were larger than 256 would reject every dynamic offset. Core WebGPU default is 256; the probe records the measured value.

hardAssumptions.name: maxSamplerAnisotropy
hardAssumptions.note: packet-consumer.js:571-574 reads this limit and falls back to 1. It is not exposed by current WebGPU implementations (measured: null), so textures are sampled without anisotropic filtering; this is a quality loss, not a boot blocker.

hardAssumptions.name: uniform buffer dynamic offsets
hardAssumptions.note: packet-consumer.js:1598,1622,1644,1659 bind group 0 with a per-draw dynamic offset; the whole per-draw uniform buffer is (draws + ghost bands + power-up slots) x 256 bytes.

drawBudget.note: River = 22 level-instance draws + 394 track draws + 123 car draws (largest committed car chunk). Amboy = 1,201 map draws + 123 car draws. Gracia = 2,627 map draws + 123 car draws. Worst-case uniform buffer adds 4 remote bands x 123 draws + 16 power-up markers + 4 ring slots = 3,262 x 256 B = 835,072 B. tools/measure_requirements.mjs recomputes these from the committed artifacts; its output is _work/compat/render-requirements.json.

wasm.evidence: wasm-opt (binaryen in _work/toolchains/emsdk) validates e1_drive.wasm with --mvp-features --enable-bulk-memory --enable-bulk-memory-opt --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-sign-ext --enable-mutable-globals (exit 0); wasm-dis shows (memory $0 4096 8192) with no shared flag. The glue (e1_drive.mjs) reads import.meta.url and uses top-level await.
wasm.memoryNote: build_module.mjs:89-90 (-sINITIAL_MEMORY=268435456 -sMAXIMUM_MEMORY=536870912 -sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1); the page therefore needs a 256 MiB linear memory at start and up to 512 MiB, but no SharedArrayBuffer.

javascript.modules: index.html:107 <script type="module" src="./app.js"> and static imports in app.js:44-97
javascript.topLevelAwait: the Emscripten ES6 glue uses `await` at module top level; reading it as a module requires top-level await support
javascript.es2022Syntax: app.js uses optional chaining, nullish coalescing, class fields and logical assignment; the probe records that the page module parsed
